skill_name: Describe the advantages and disadvantages of using robots in healthcare
workflow: The advantages of using robots in healthcare are many. Robots can be used to help surgeons perform minimally invasive medical procedures, provide medical supplies for those unable to access hospitals, or assist nurses with patient care. Robots can also be used to automate the delivery of medications, which can reduce the errors that are associated with manual drug delivery.
